review_candidates.title: Senior Automation Tester
review_candidates.description: Company Description Amjaad Technology is a leading corporation in IoT and utility management, specializing in smart metering solutions for electricity, water, BTU, and gas. The company’s innovative ioMeter System supports utility service providers, real estate developers, and smart cities in driving digital transformation and optimizing energy management. Amjaad Technology develops platforms for community and facilities management in smart cities to enhance efficiency, resource utilization, and streamline operations. With over 300 projects delivered across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, the company’s solutions have positively impacted more than 200,000 people and contributed to sustainable, future-ready communities. Role Description The Senior Automation Tester is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. This role involves designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and scripts for web, mobile, and backend systems that support Amjaad’s smart metering and IoT platforms. The Senior Automation Tester will create and execute detailed test cases, perform API and integration testing, validate data flows, and ensure system reliability and performance. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with developers and product teams, reviewing requirements and technical designs, identifying defects, documenting findings, and contributing to continuous improvement of QA processes and test coverage. The role also includes mentoring junior testers, promoting best practices in test automation, and supporting release planning and regression testing. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Quality Assurance skills, including test planning, test design, defect management, and familiarity with QA methodologies and standards. Candidates should possess Manual Testing skills, with experience in creating and executing Test Cases and scenarios across functional, regression, and integration testing. Candidates should possess API Testing skills, including use of tools such as Postman, REST-assured, or similar, and an understanding of RESTful services and JSON/XML formats. Candidates should possess Automation skills, including building and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar. Relevant experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control tools (e.g., Git) to integrate automated tests into the build and deployment process. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on reliability and performance in complex, data-driven systems. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate clearly in English, and document test results and technical issues in a structured manner. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; prior experience in IoT, utilities, or smart city solutions is an advantage.
